narrative.overview: reportAi is a working ledger, not a showroom: the category's familiar language executed at Linear/Stripe craft, with provenance (confidence, model id, null values, SQL, similarity, citations) treated as first-class content. Moderate, tool-like density; neutrals, one provenance blue and four type hues; light and dark follow the system.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral warm-gray ground with white (near-black in dark) bordered panels
Inter for everything human, JetBrains Mono only for data, ids, code and figures
Ink-colored primary actions; blue appears only where something is traced or focused
Honest emptiness: absent values render as a muted mono null
Live process state (the four-step pipeline) instead of decorative hero content

rules.name: The Provenance Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "this is traced or focused": citations, the source row they light, focus and selection. Never decoration, wordmarks, headings or primary buttons.

rules.name: The Ink Action Rule
rules.body: The primary action is an ink button, one per panel.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks machine values. If a human reads it as prose, it is Inter.

rules.name: The Border-Or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Panels declare elevation once, with a hairline border; never with an added soft shadow.

dos: Do show what the model returned exactly, rendering absent values as a muted mono null.
Do put machine values (ids, amounts, SQL, JSON, model ids, similarity) in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
Do keep provenance visible at first glance: confidence, method chip, executed SQL and cited sources.
Do collapse tables into stacked label/value rows on narrow screens instead of horizontal scrolling.
Do use skeleton bars for loading content, and a 14px spinner only beside a status line.
donts: Don't use provenance blue outside citations, focus, selection and the drop target.
Don't add a shadow to a bordered panel, or nest filled tiles inside panels; use hairline dividers.
Don't hide technique behind decoration: no collapsing confidence or similarity into icons.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or eyebrows above headings.
